Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City x.vww.dilg.qov.ph S. 2024- OILG OPINION NO. IO JAN 1 1 HON. SHAIRA A.DURAN HON. CRISZIA ANGELA A. TIAMZON HON. MARRIANE M. MARQUEZ HON. KYGEL D. RUFINO Sangguniang Kabataan Members Barangay San Juan Cainta, Rizal Gentleman and Ladies: This pertains to your letter dated November 22, 2023 manifesting your non- concurrence to the appointments of Mr. Ello John Miole and Mr. Gerorge Adelene G. Ibanez as SK Secretary and SK Treasurer, respectively. Per the antecedent facts submitted, you do not concur to the appointment made by the SK Chairperson because of the following: I. The appointees lack the necessary qualifications suitable for the positions; 2. There is no deliberation on the qualifications of the appointees; 3. One prospective appointee was found to be violating one of the grounds for disapproval of appointment; 4. Preference on the educational background. Per our evaluation, no specific request is being asked from the Department. Nevertheless, we would like to apprise you of the following discussions, for your guidance. May it respectfully informed that the manifestation presented herein can be paralleled with DILG Legal Opinion No. 17, S. 2009, pertinently, it provides: Article II, Sections 4 and 5 of DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2002-150 provide that: Section 4. Pending Compliance with the condition of concurrence, the appointee, in the exigency of public service, shall be allowed to discharge and perform the powers, duties and responsibilities pertaining to the office and they shall be considered to be holding a temporary appointment. Section 5. pursuant to Section 5 of RA 6713, otherwise known as the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Official Employees, the Sangguninan Barangay shall act on the appointment within fifteen (15) working days from receipt of the appointment as submitted by the punong barangay. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54



In the case of Alquizola vs. Ocoll, the Supreme Court ruled that the power to appoint is to be exercised conjointly by the Punong Barangay and majority of all the members of the Sangguniang Barangay. Such being the case, the correlative duty of the members of the Sangguniang Barangay being referred to would now be required concurrence, and pending concurrence, being the final phase of the appointment, shall make the appointment temporary. Further, Section 13(f) of Rep. Act No. 10742, as amended by Rep. Act No. 11768, states that the SK Chairperson, with the concurrence of the majority of all the SK Members, appoint from among the members of the Katipunan ng Kabataan (KK) secretary and a treasurer. Applying the foregoing, we are of the view that appointment of SK Secretary and SK Treasurer may only be recognized as valid jn accordance with law upon the concurrence by the majority members of the SK Members. Without the conjoint action of appointment and concurrence, neither an appointment nor a replacement can be effectua12. The appointed SK Secretary and SK Treasurer may assume her duties in an acting capacity pending concurrence by the majority members of the SK. However, one the SK Members expresses officially its non-concurrence to the appointment, the SK Secretary and SK Treasurer shall not anymore be allowed to perform her duties. May it be emphasized, however, that while the power to concur is given to the SK Members, said body is not vested with so much plenary discretionary powers. The power to concur is intended for the sanggunian to determine whether the appointee of the SK Chairperson possesses all the qualifications and none of the disqualifications prescribed for SK Secretary and SK Treasurer under Rep. Act No. 10742, as amended by Rep. Act No. 11768 and such other qualifications provided by existing laws. If the appointee, therefore, possesses all the qualifications provided by law, then the SK Members has no other far-reaching powers except to issue the concurrence3. This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: A . ROMEO P. BENITEZ Officer-in-Charge, OUSELLA OUSELLNRPB/LRALLD/rrao copy furnished: ARIEL O. IGLESIA, CESO Ill Regional Director.
